steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ event instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required post-expiry surrogate-bid configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Apply the required evaluation-reopen configuration.
Reach the RFQ Responses view where the case opens Settings.
Confirm the RFQ Responses screen is ready before opening its Settings menu.
Open Recreate Order from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Confirm the Recreate Order window is open.
Set the recreated order's event end-time duration to 60.
Verify the selected event end-time duration.
Enter the required 45-minute evaluation duration.
Verify the evaluation duration before submission.
Choose the specified future delivery date.
Verify the selected delivery date.
Submit the valid Recreate Order form.
Verify the expected success confirmation when shown.
Confirm the resulting RFQ detail page shows the recreated order's 60-minute end-time value.
Confirm the resulting RFQ detail page shows the recreated order's 45-minute evaluation duration.
Confirm the resulting RFQ detail page shows the recreated order's delivery date.
